numericPolicy: All scenario dimensions, acceptance limits, variation fields, uncertainty half-widths and survival inputs are synthetic teaching choices. Citations support mechanisms and mathematical principles, not these presets or a modern manufacturing recipe.

sources.title: Deal and Grove: General Relationship for the Thermal Oxidation of Silicon — theoretical excerpt
sources.locator: Reproduced theoretical sections 1–2 of the 1965 paper
sources.supports: Oxidant transport through an existing oxide and reaction at the silicon interface; distinction between oxide growth and deposition.
sources.excludes: The illustrative 0.44 silicon-consumption factor is not established by this excerpt. No rate constants, oxidation time, modern thin-oxide accuracy or calibrated kinetics are adopted.

sources.title: MIT 3.155J/6.152J: Chemical Vapor Deposition
sources.supports: Poly-Si as a deposited film; precursor transport, surface reaction and removal of byproducts. A deposited target film is distinct from a thermally grown oxide.
sources.excludes: The model prescribes thickness instead of solving a CVD reactor. No numeric film thickness, transport coefficient or process temperature is imported.

sources.title: ASML: Six crucial steps in semiconductor manufacturing
sources.locator: Photoresist coating and Lithography sections, updated October 4, 2023
sources.supports: Exposure changes the solubility of positive resist; a latent image precedes physical removal.
sources.excludes: The article's simplified Etch section groups development and target etching together. This model separates them using the MIT dry-etch process sequence. No resolution or CD prescription is adopted.

sources.title: MIT 3.155J/6.152J: Dry Etching
sources.supports: A developed mask precedes target transfer; etch selectivity and directional removal are distinct. Material removal can consume mask and affect an underlying layer.
sources.excludes: Constant selectivity, prescribed CD bias and ideal vertical rectangles are teaching assumptions. Loading, sidewall chemistry, roughness, plasma distributions and endpoint dynamics are not solved.

sources.title: JCGM 106:2012 — The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment
sources.supports: Acceptance decisions depend on stated specifications and measurement uncertainty. Guarded acceptance distinguishes confident containment from boundary overlap.
sources.excludes: The model uses deterministic interval containment with a declared half-width, not the source's probabilistic risk calculations. No coverage probability, instrument traceability, standard compliance or real qualification is claimed.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH: Control charts
sources.locator: What are the differences between control limits and specification limits?
sources.supports: Specification limits concern intended performance; statistical control limits concern process consistency.
sources.excludes: The synthetic acceptance limits are not SPC limits. No control chart, process stability conclusion or process capability index is produced.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH: Poisson Distribution
sources.supports: For a Poisson event count with mean lambda, the zero-event probability is exp(-lambda).
sources.excludes: Uniform defect density over die area, lambda = density × area, and independence from geometric acceptance are explicit atlas assumptions. The source does not establish modern semiconductor yield behavior.

sources.title: Samsung Develops Industry-First 36GB HBM3E 12H DRAM
sources.supports: A named HBM implementation uses thermocompression with non-conductive film; bumps and supporting material have distinct roles.
sources.excludes: The atlas does not reproduce Samsung geometry, process conditions, yield, thermal results or product qualification.

sources.title: SK hynix: Small Size, Big Impact
sources.supports: Mass reflow forms interconnects and molded underfill occupies the inter-die region; these are separate material and process roles.
sources.excludes: No vendor throughput, alloy composition, pad dimensions or route superiority is inferred. The atlas remains a material-role illustration.

sources.title: imec: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding — pushing the boundaries to 400nm interconnect pitch
sources.locator: February 19, 2024; Current process flow and Accurate control of surface topography sections
sources.supports: Hybrid bonding combines prepared dielectric surfaces and copper interconnects; surface preparation and registration matter.
sources.excludes: The reported research test vehicle is not a qualified HBM product. Atlas pad width, exaggerated local gap and acceptance offsets are synthetic; overlap does not determine resistance, yield or lifetime.
